remarks: Third floor one bedroom deluxe Type "F" layout at the premier Tamarack Club. This is a fractional ownership giving you 10-11 weeks per year, or about 1 week per month. Your weeks do rotate so in a five year cycle you end up getting all 52 weeks. Weeks are all pre-assigned. This unit is located on our lobby level giving you easy access from the parking lot to your room. Ownership amenities include year 'round access to the heated indoor/outdoor pool, private locker room, private owner's lounge, valet parking, and underground parking while lodging overnight. This is Ellicottville living at a "fraction of the cost!"
